name: Columbia Men's Eager Air Interchange Jacket - Black (Large), Men's Size I Large Color Black
description: Part of the Interchange System, the three-in-one Columbia Mens Eager Air Interchange Jacket features a Hydra Cloth 3,000 waterproof nylon shell to keep the rain where it belongs. Inside of the lightweight shell resides a 100% polyester MTR filament fleece liner jacket that zips in or out depending on the weather. The 100% nylon outer shell delivers Omni-Shield advanced repellency to resist rain and stains. This waterproof jacket sports easy-moving nylon taffeta lining, an adjustable three-piece hood, handwarmer pockets, an interior security pocket, a drop tail for extra coverage, a drawcord-adjustable hem and hook-and-loop-adjustable cuffs. The inner jacket boasts 100% polyester MTR filament fleece that is soft, warm and breathable. The fleece liner has a full-zip front, handwarmer pockets and a standup collar. The three-season design is constructed so that you can wear just the shell for rain and wind protection, just the liner for warmth or both pieces zipped together for total protection from the elements. Machine wash. Imported. Sizes: S-4XL, 3X-4X. Colors: Black, Graphite, Navy, Trail, Mountain (not shown), Elderberry (not shown). Size: Large. Color: Black. Gender: Male. Age Group: Adult. Material: Polyester. Type: Jackets.
